```{=html}
<style>
    #quarto-document-content {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: none;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-right: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        margin-left: 0;
        padding-right: 0;
        padding-top: 0;
        padding-left: 0;
    }

    #quarto-content {
        display: block;
        background: #d0ced1;
    }

    #quarto-margin-sidebar {
        display: none;
    }

    .cv-iframe-page {
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        background: #d0ced1;
    }

    .responsive-iframe-container {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        height: calc(100dvh - 190px);
        min-height: 720px;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: #d0ced1;
    }

    .responsive-iframe-container iframe {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        border: none;
        display: block;
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] #quarto-content,
    html[data-theme="dark"] .cv-iframe-page,
    html[data-theme="dark"] .responsive-iframe-container {
        background: #1b211f;
    }
</style>
```

        <iframe src="web/viewer.html?file=CV_ARG.pdf" title="CV de Alejandro Romero González"></iframe>

</div>
